Container.Name: KeepSift
Container.Overview: KeepSift cleans out a huge Gmail inbox with your own local AI, without losing the emails that matter. It scans Gmail's Promotions, Social, Updates and Forums tabs, groups years of mail by sender, and removes the senders you pick, either by labelling them "To Delete" for review or by moving them to Gmail Trash (recoverable for 30 days). Every email first passes a rule-based safety net that keeps product and license keys, activation, verification and sign-in links, codes, gift cards, receipts, attachments and starred mail, and learns each sender's repeated footer so boilerplate doesn't block cleanup. An optional model double-check catches what rules can't. It can also sort new mail, flag phishing and write reply drafts for you to review. Works with any OpenAI-compatible model server (llama.cpp, LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM); your email is never sent to a cloud AI. The full app opens in your browser. Free for non-commercial use (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0). Provided as is, with no warranty and no liability for deleted email: start with the "To Delete" label and Preview, and keep a backup.
Container.Requires: An OpenAI-compatible model server reachable from the container, such as llama.cpp, LM Studio, Ollama or vLLM, with a 14B+ instruction-tuned model recommended (7B minimum). Inside the container "localhost" is the container itself, so set Model Server URL to your server's LAN address, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8080/v1. A Gmail app password (Google account, Security, App passwords; needs 2-Step Verification) and IMAP turned on in Gmail settings. Open the Web UI and the setup wizard walks you through Gmail, the model and your name. The app password is stored in App Data, so if anyone else can reach this port, turn on Web Login below.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for KeepSift in your browser.

Config.Name: VNC Port
Config.Description: Optional: direct VNC access with a VNC client. Leave empty to not expose it.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Settings, Gmail login (.env), history database and logs.

Config.Name: Model Server URL
Config.Description: Your OpenAI-compatible server, ending in /v1, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8080/v1 (llama.cpp), :1234/v1 (LM Studio), :11434/v1 (Ollama). Pre-fills the setup wizard on first start; change it later under Settings, Model.

Config.Name: Web Login
Config.Description: Set to 1 to require a username and password for the Web UI. Recommended if anyone else can reach this port, since the Gmail app password is stored inside.

Config.Name: Allow Web Login over http
Config.Description: Web Login normally requires https (Secure Connection). 1 allows it over plain http on your LAN; set to 0 and Secure Connection to 1 for https.

Config.Name: Secure Connection
Config.Description: Set to 1 to serve the Web UI over https with a self-signed certificate.

Config.Name: Display Width
Config.Description: Width of the app's screen in pixels.

Config.Name: Display Height
Config.Description: Height of the app's screen in pixels.

Config.Name: Dark Web UI
Config.Description: Set to 1 for a dark frame around the app. KeepSift's own light/dark switch is in its header.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 = users on Unraid).

Config.Name: Umask
Config.Description: Permission mask for files KeepSift creates in App Data.
